**Finding: compliant (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).**

The agreement satisfies the preferred checklist in full:

- **Deliverable ownership + assignment** — § 14.2: we own each Deliverable created specifically for us, with Vendor's present assignment of all worldwide right, title and interest and back-to-back assignments from its personnel.
- **Vendor pre-existing IP retained** — § 14.3 with § 1.8 (Vendor Technology excludes Customer Data and our pre-Effective-Date IP).
- **Embedded Vendor IP licence** — § 13.2 is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, with use/modify/derivative rights for our business, expressly applied to embedded Vendor Technology by § 14.3.
- **Customer Data** — § 14.1 confirms our ownership and limits Vendor to processing solely to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for us (service delivery, not independent exploitation), reinforced by § 15.1's no-sale/no-advertising/no-model-training restrictions.
- **No joint ownership** — § 14.4, default no joint IP; feedback rights preserved for us.

No redline proposed. Minor, non-flagged observations: § 14.2 conditions Deliverable ownership on payment of applicable Fees, and § 15.1 carries an "as permitted by this Agreement" processing hook. The revocable Services licence in § 13.1 is a LICENSE-rule matter and was not double-flagged here.
